blocks.text: AI is great for budgets, tables and Excel or Google Sheets formulas – even if you don't like numbers.

My monthly income is [AMOUNT]. Expenses: rent, food, transport, bills, phone. Make me a budget table suggesting how much to set aside for each item and for savings, using the 50/30/20 rule, and explain the rule.
Describe in words what you want and the AI will write the formula. For example: "Column B has prices, column C quantities. I need the grand total in D1."
In a Google Sheets table, column A has dates and column B has expense amounts. Write a formula that adds up only the October expenses and explain it step by step.
Check a formula's result by hand on a few examples before you trust it. And for sums inside a chat message – AI sometimes miscalculates, so ask it to use a table or a calculation tool.
Claude can analyse a table you add (e.g. CSV or Excel) and make a chart or a report.
ChatGPT can open an Excel file, do the calculations and make charts.
Gemini also works inside Google Sheets, where it can help directly in the table (on some plans).
